title: Erasing Substrings
statementMd:
You are given a string $*s*$, initially consisting of $*n*$ lowercase Latin letters. After that, you perform $*k*$ operations with it, where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c9622f3cdf5f8480656b83e566988d23d6c716b5.png). During $*i*$-th operation you **must** erase some substring of length exactly $2^{*i* - 1}$ from $*s*$.

Print the lexicographically minimal string you may obtain after performing $*k*$ such operations.

## Input

The only line contains one string $*s*$ consisting of $*n*$ lowercase Latin letters ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000$).

## Output

Print the lexicographically minimal string you may obtain after performing $*k*$ operations.

## Note

Possible operations in examples:

1. adcb**c**a ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) a**dc**ba ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) aba;
2. ab**a**cabadabacaba ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) a**bc**abadabacaba ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) aaba**daba**caba ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) aabacaba.
